summary: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose monthly NAV-based offering prices, declared regular distributions, and provided portfolio updates. No special situation event occurred; the filing is routine disclosure for a business development company. It reports NAV per share, distribution amounts per class, and portfolio composition as of June 30, 2026. This is operational reporting with no transactional, strategic, or corporate action implications.
